newsitem.title: USA: Inmark listing on Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
newsitem.headline: Inmark listing on Nasdaq SmallCap Market.

text.p: Inmark Enterprises Inc said its publicly held securities were approved for listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market from Tuesday.
The securities, trading on the over the counter electronic bulletin board since September 28, 1994, include Inmark's common stock, units, class A warrants and class B warrants.
Inmark is a marketing and sales promotion company which designs, develops and implements sales, marketing and promotional programs primarily for consumer product client companies.
